rows.note: Written: the desired covariance property is said to be lacking for the fundamental class, while the class is said to have order dividing 2. The supplied mathematical correction says that, if the involution acts on the class by negation, a class killed by 2 is already invariant; the remaining issue concerns choosing a gerbe lift of order 2. This is a mathematical objection/refinement, not a missing phrase visible in the ink, so preserve the source. The existing covariance/conservation and h/b doubt macros remain unchanged; the h/b symbol remains a genuine residual ink doubt. The geometric inversion formula and the gerbe-lifting claim were not independently verified.

additional_events.outcome: Checked the conditional additive-group calculation only: if h+h=0 and the involution acts by h↦−h, then −h=h, so the class is fixed. This verifies the proposed class-level observation under the supplied action. It does not establish that inversion is the actual geometric action in this setting, nor existence of a lift to the gerbe or the possibility of choosing such a lift of order 2.
